name: knowledge-loop
description: A self-improving, folder-scoped memory + auto-learning loop: capture confidence-scored learnings as agents work, auto-surface the most relevant prior learnings at session start via local hybrid (TF-IDF + keyword, RRF-fused) search with recency decay and importance/usefulness/confidence weighting, consolidate to forget stale low-confidence notes, and /evolve recurring lessons into draft reusable skills.
